origin.description: Read newline-delimited JSON into a data frame.

arguments.name: con
arguments.text: A text stream or a file path.

origin.details: Blank lines are skipped. The default handler binds every page.
origin.example:
con <- textConnection(c('{"a":1,"b":"x"}', '{"a":2,"b":"y"}'))
df <- stream_in(con, verbose = FALSE)
cat(paste(df$a, df$b, collapse = "|"), "\n", sep = "")

translation.description: Parses each non-empty line and binds the objects.

arguments.name: con
arguments.text: A text stream or a file path.

translation.details: A path is read as UTF-8. A stream is read to the end.
translation.example:
import io
from jsonlite import stream_in
frame = stream_in(io.StringIO('{"a":1,"b":"x"}\n{"a":2,"b":"y"}\n'))
print("|".join(f"{a} {b}" for a, b in zip(frame.columns["a"], frame.columns["b"])))
